description: This Python source file contains utility functions, classes, and enums related to Google Cloud Vertex AI integration within the litellm project. It includes model routing logic, URL construction, schema manipulation, error handling, and token counting for Vertex AI models. The file appears to facilitate managing different Vertex AI deployment scenarios, support features like response schemas, and handle various model types and configurations specific to Vertex AI and Gemini.
